apps.localizedDescription:
ProCraft (retired):

This repository is retired. v0.11.0 (2026-11-02) is the final release: no further features, fixes or support will be published here.

That project has its own maintainers and codebase; this repository is not part of it and is not affiliated with it. The v0.11.0 builds below stay online for anyone still using them.

By surfrpt1.

An open-source, clean-room raster painting studio in pure Rust: layered painting, a soft-round brush engine, and PNG import/export. Inspired by professional painting workflows; every line of code and every asset here is original.

Trademark note: "Procreate" is a registered trademark of Savage Interactive. ProCraft is an independent project with its own name, branding and code, and is not affiliated with or endorsed by any other vendor.

versions.localizedDescription:
This repository is retired. v0.11.0 is the final release: no fixes or builds will be added here.

v0.11.0 is the 8K canvas release: painting stays responsive on very large documents, projects save and reopen tile by tile, and tools that used to abort on a big canvas now report out-of-memory and roll back cleanly.

8K canvas + lazy compositing:

• Layer pixels live in 256 px copy-on-write tiles: painting, undo, layer moves, fills, text, liquify and masks all work tile by tile, with no separate path for large canvases.
• Canvases grow to 8192 px (1080p / 4K / 8K presets) with a live layer + cache memory readout.

• Project format v12 saves per-tile payloads and omits all-zero tiles; v1-v11 projects still open.

Faster, steadier tools:

• Shape fills rasterise by scanline spans instead of a per-pixel ray cast.
• Box blur runs row-major, so filter previews stop stalling.
• Animation playback reuses one texture and blends frames as integers.
• Brush, fill and liquify paths stay dense across tile seams, with seam regression tests.

Crash safety:

• Out-of-memory is reported instead of aborting: liquify strokes roll back, transforms and filters fail cleanly, exports and saves return errors, and big-canvas texture guards degrade to the viewport renderer.
• Corrupt project and brush files are rejected instead of panicking.

Layers and masks:

• Group actions menu: reorder, move a layer out of a group, multi-select and group the selection, group the active layer.
• Layer and group renames are undoable.
• Maskless layers fall back to the correct mask view instead of dropping it.

Mobile:

• Android falls back to the GLES renderer when wgpu is unavailable.
• Slide-over drawers stay above their dim layer, dialogs remain interactive, and the reference card opens in its own window.
• Clearer top-bar pills, a faded File-menu row, centred mobile sheets, and the tablet file/view islands stay apart.

Brushes:

• Chalk and Airbrush are back to their dense reference look; Round keeps a round cap at both ends of a stroke; Marker lays a richer chisel band; Pencil paints in full colour.
• Per-tool brush settings persist across relaunches.
• Small Chalk grain fix and restored liquify pull.

Pages are capped at 8192 px per side, and layer tiles are allocated only where you paint. A never-painted page costs nothing; a fully painted layer roughly costs:

• Pages above 2048 px, and any page larger than the GPU's texture limit, draw through the viewport renderer: only the visible rectangle is composited and uploaded, so 4K/8K do not need a 64/256 MB canvas texture in VRAM. At fit zoom below 75% the same path draws a box-filtered view.
• Composite tiles keep a 96 MB cache on phones/tablets and 320 MB on desktop; the Layers panel shows live layer memory.
• Undo keeps up to 32 steps and at most 256 MB per stack. Big pages are byte-limited rather than step-limited (a full 8K layer edit is the one-step worst case); a normal stroke only stores the tiles it touched.

• Saving is tile-based (format v12) and skips empty tiles, but a fully painted multi-layer 8K project is still a large file.
• GIF import is capped at 4096 px per side. On Android the app falls back to the GLES renderer when wgpu cannot start.

Windows: unzip, run procraft.exe. iOS 17+: sideload the IPA. Android 10+: install the APK (allow unknown apps once).
